description: Character-level BIO tagger trained on weak labels: hfl/chinese-roberta-wwm-ext plus one linear layer over 13 labels (O, B-/I- of six types), partial-label loss (a one-label set is ordinary cross-entropy; an all-13 set is left out). The setting (S1/S2/S3) picks the weak build's label file; only its 'train' chapters (1-780 minus the 31 dev chapters) are used, and the weak build's record (runs/<weak_build>/config.json) must match the label file's sha256, the snapshot and the training chapters. Dev (the answered dev chapters in gold_dev) picks the checkpoint inside a run (best strict micro F1, ties: earlier) and, across runs, the setting. Hyperparameters are the common defaults from the backbone survey, fixed before any run, not tuned on dev. AdamW applies weight_decay to weight matrices only (not biases or LayerNorm). quote_map: six characters the HFL vocabulary lacks, replaced one for one before tokenizing so offsets do not move. deterministic: torch deterministic algorithms in strict mode (an op without a deterministic version stops the run), so the same seed repeats exactly.

backbone.download_note: pytorch_model.bin 411,578,458 bytes plus small tokenizer files (about 412 MB); no safetensors in the repo
